{'text': '《每日秀》主持人大約翰·斯圖爾特（Jon Stewart）週一聽到報道，指總統特朗普（Donald Trump）上週訪問華盛頓期間，曾向中國國家主席習近平提出出售美國武器，他對此感到震驚。', 'gloss': 'The Daily Show host Jon Stewart was shocked on Monday when he heard reports that President Donald Trump proposed selling American weapons to Chinese President Xi Jinping during his visit to Washington last week.'}

{'text': '「搞什麼鬼？」斯圖爾特雙手抱頭，顯得相當無奈。「美國到底係點樣仲能夠喺地圖上面企穩？有時真係唔知⋯⋯點解我哋唔直接滑落大海？」', 'gloss': '"What the hell?" Stewart held his head in his hands, looking quite helpless. "How on earth can America still stand on the map? Sometimes I really don\'t know... why don\'t we just slide right off into the ocean?"'}

{'text': '呢個所謂嘅提議係由美國駐華大使戴維·珀杜（David Perdue）轉述，背景係有報道指中國正向伊朗提供武器、情報同石油交易。', 'gloss': 'The alleged proposal was relayed by US Ambassador to China David Perdue, against the backdrop of reports that China is providing weapons, intelligence, and oil transactions to Iran.'}

{'text': '「我要親耳聽到總統自己講先得，」斯圖爾特話。「我唔會信。特朗普真係提出過賣武器畀中國？」', 'gloss': '"I need to hear the president say it with my own ears first," Stewart said. "I won\'t believe it. Did Trump really propose selling weapons to China?"'}

{'text': '斯圖爾特隨即播放咗一段記者向特朗普查詢呢個所謂提議嘅片段。', 'gloss': 'Stewart then played a clip of a reporter asking Trump about the alleged proposal.'}

{'text': '特朗普話：「我從未聽過呢件事。我要去問吓佢。佢哋應該會想買，因為我哋嘅裝備確實比佢哋好。所以或者呢個係個好主意。」', 'gloss': 'Trump said: "I\'ve never heard of this. I\'m going to ask him about it. They would probably want to buy, because our equipment is indeed better than theirs. So maybe this is a good idea."'}

{'text': '呢番說話令斯圖爾特確信屬實。', 'gloss': 'These words convinced Stewart that it was true.'}

{'text': '「佢真係同佢哋提議賣武器啦。」斯圖爾特話。「天呀——你幾乎可以見到特朗普喺度度緊數：『嗯，如果伊朗用我哋造嘅武器打贏我哋，即係等於我哋打贏咗呢場仗。我贏喇。』」', 'gloss': '"He really did propose selling weapons to them." Stewart said. "Oh my god — you can almost see Trump doing the math: \'Well, if Iran wins against us using weapons we made, that means we won this war. I won.\'"'}
